edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller and mint recipient and drives the characterMinted guard in mintCharacter
msg.sender is the recipient address for the minted rocket parts
migration compares block.timestamp against tTimestamp plus pPeriod to end the game
validatePartType requires ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender
claimEachRocketPartWin pays the win amount to msg.sender
claimFullSetOfColors routes the final payout to msg.sender
msg.sender is mixed into the random number and is the mint recipient
ETH sent to the owner is triggered by the caller controlled mintCharacter flow
External value transfer to the caller enables reentrancy on claimEachRocketPartWin
External value transfer to the caller enables reentrancy on validateColorsAndBurn
mintCharacter executes payable(owner()).transfer(ownerCut) on the non-presale path
mintRocketParts executes payable(owner()).transfer(ownerCut) after the mint loop
mintCharacter is guarded by the gameNotEnded modifier
mintRocketParts is guarded by the gameNotEnded modifier
claimEachRocketPartWin is guarded by the gameNotEnded modifier
claimFullSetOfColors is guarded by the gameNotEnded modifier
updateSale is restricted by onlyOwner
updatePresale is restricted by onlyOwner

gameNotEnded reads the hasGameEnded state flag
mintCharacter reads and increments charactersMinted
mintCharacter writes the _characterMinted wallet flag
mintRocketParts increments rocketPartsMinted in the loop

claimEachRocketPartWin validates each of the six parts via validatePartType
claimEachRocketPartWin transfers half the balance to the caller
claimFullSetOfColors delegates burning and payout to validateColorsAndBurn
validateColorsAndBurn validates each colored part via validatePartType
validateColorsAndBurn transfers the computed win amount to the caller

migration drains the whole contract balance to the owner
migration depends on block.timestamp for its readiness check
migration writes and reads the tTimestamp state variable
block.timestamp is consumed by the timestamp dependent game end logic
mintRandomRocketPart relies on weak on-chain randomness sources

tokenURI reads _tokenIdToMetadata to build the JSON metadata

addRocketPartSupply writes packed part types into _rocketPartTypes
